tokens.name: acid
tokens.usage: The brand colour. The one filled colour in the product: the primary action in dark mode, the walkthrough card, badge chips, the milestone unlock card and the logo's acid colourway. Never as text on the light page (1.1:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The app's ink. Text and icons on acid (16.8:1), and the solid fill that stands in for acid as the primary action in light mode.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill in light mode (primary buttons, the re-identify pill).

tokens.name: logo-black
tokens.usage: The black colourway of every logo file. Logos only.

tokens.name: logo-white
tokens.usage: The white colourway of every logo file. Logos only.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (--bg-hex). Dark is the default theme; light is a warm paper, not white.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: The sticky header: bg at 80% over a 24px blur, saturate 180%.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Top stop of the glass panel gradient (135deg, to fg at 0.02). Section panels, sheets, the account panel.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Top stop of an AddCard (145deg). Dark runs to fg 0.03; light runs to rgba(252,249,240,0.88) and is nearly opaque.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Flat quiet fill: glassSubtle rows and inset panels.

tokens.name: fill-pill
tokens.usage: Pill and stat chip fill, always with border-hairline.

tokens.name: fill-ghost
tokens.usage: The ghost icon tile on a secondary AddCard, with a 1px inset ring of border-strong-ish fg 0.12.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover (track rows, list rows).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal overlays (walkthrough, unlock card), with an 8px blur.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default panel border (glass).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header bottom rule, pill borders, the AddCard footer rule (0.08). Light mode strengthens the header rule to 0.10.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button borders and inputs (vv-search-btn).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg (17.9:1 dark, 18.3:1 light).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised values on bg: pill values, track titles (14.5:1 / 16.4:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and section labels on bg (7.3:1 / 11.4:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, kickers, the dimmed second line of the home heading. On bg: 3.7:1 in dark FAILS 4.5:1 for small text; passes only at 24px+. Light 6.3:1. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Eyebrows (the home tagline). On bg 2.5:1 dark and 4.45:1 light: both FAIL 4.5:1. Kept exact from the source; prefer text-muted or text-secondary in new work.

tokens.name: on-acid-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy on acid (walkthrough body), 7.3:1.

tokens.name: on-acid-muted
tokens.usage: Step counter on acid, 3.6:1: FAILS 4.5:1 at its 10px size. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: on-acid-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled segments of the walkthrough progress rail. Decorative; the current segment is ink.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The primary action fill. Acid on dark; ink on light, because acid on the light page is 1.1:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: acid-glow
tokens.usage: Coloured drop shadow under the acid re-identify pill (0 4px 14px -6px).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text on bg (10.7:1 / 6.1:1), set in mono.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Error box fill, radius-input, with danger-border.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Error box border.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text on bg (14.5:1 dark). Light 4.0:1 FAILS 4.5:1 for small text; the light value comes from the condition grade select. Pair with a word or icon: never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unverified scans, draft imports, waiting on Discogs (11.8:1 / 4.9:1).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Online presence dot and unread count badge, with black text (9.2:1).

tokens.name: crate-purple
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Also the Digger tier sticker. Black type on it is 2.6:1: FAILS, despite the source comment that every crate takes black type. Use white type.

tokens.name: crate-violet
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Also the Resident tier sticker. Black type 7.8:1.

tokens.name: crate-cyan
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Black type 14.6:1.

tokens.name: crate-blue
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Black type 6.9:1.

tokens.name: crate-lime
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Close to acid by design; never use it as the brand colour.

tokens.name: crate-emerald
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Black type 8.9:1.

tokens.name: crate-amber
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Black type 11.5:1.

tokens.name: crate-coral
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Black type 6.9:1.

tokens.name: crate-magenta
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Black type 5.9:1.

tokens.name: crate-slate
tokens.usage: Crate colour. Black type 6.3:1.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Home greeting at md and up. Two lines, the second in text-muted.
styles.sample: Stack your wax the easy way.

styles.name: display-hero-mobile
styles.usage: Home greeting on phones.
styles.sample: Stack your wax the easy way.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Sheet and card titles (Tailwind 2xl, rescaled). Walkthrough step titles.

styles.name: display-card
styles.usage: Hero AddCard title at sm and up (21px on phones).

styles.name: track-title
styles.usage: Track titles in a tracklist (18px on phones).

styles.name: track-artist
styles.usage: Per-track artist on compilations only, italic, at fg 0.52.

styles.name: display-tile
styles.usage: Compact AddCard titles (16px on phones).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy (Tailwind sm, rescaled 1.25x). Walkthrough body uses 1.625 leading.
styles.sample: Every track gets a BPM for building sets.

styles.name: body-compact
styles.usage: Dense copy: roadmap descriptions, list detail.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Subtitles under card titles, in text-muted.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button label (walkthrough Next).

styles.name: button-secondary
styles.usage: Outlined secondary buttons (Remove duplicates).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase. The home tagline in the eyebrow slot.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase. GlassSection headings, in text-secondary.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. ConfidenceBadge text, field labels.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase. Pill labels and AddCard kickers.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Track positions, durations, BPM, record counts. Tabular figures.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Uppercase. Hints under AddCard titles.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Walkthrough step counter, on-acid-muted.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: BadgeChip name, ink on acid.

styles.name: error
styles.usage: Error messages, in danger.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale; the steps below are the ones the app actually uses most.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, kicker to title.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside pills and badges (gap-1.5, 70 uses).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The default gap between siblings (gap-2, 90 uses).

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Pill horizontal padding, button vertical padding (py-2.5), track row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps, tier row gap, AddCard icon to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard horizontal padding (px-4), compact card padding, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Header side gutter on phones (px-5), section spacing (mb-5), glass panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above a panel's controls (mb-6).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Walkthrough card padding (px-7) and hero AddCard vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Header side gutter at md and up (md:px-10), home top padding.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Progress bars and the badge progress track.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Inline buttons set in style props (borderRadius 9).

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Error boxes and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Full-width buttons, track rows, cover art (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass section panels, icon tiles (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: AddCards and the BadgeChip.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The walkthrough card (rounded-3xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, play buttons, avatars, status dots (rounded-full, 171 uses: the commonest shape in the app).

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels, with border and a 48px blur.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: AddCards on the home screen: a lit top rim, a shaded bottom rim and a long soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-art
tokens.usage: Under sleeve art. Keep the spread small so the shadow keeps the art's radius.

tokens.name: shadow-acid
tokens.usage: Under the primary pill (re-identify).

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Range slider thumbs (BPM filter).

blur.note: backdrop-filter blur radii, paired with the glass surfaces.

tokens.name: blur-panel
tokens.usage: Glass panels, with saturate 200%.

tokens.name: blur-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header, with saturate 180%.

tokens.name: blur-card
tokens.usage: AddCards in dark mode (44px with saturate 240% in light).

tokens.name: blur-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind overlays.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Walkthrough overlay and full-screen cards.
